sources.title: MONAI Model Zoo - GitHub
sources.snippet: MONAI Model Zoo hosts a collection of medical imaging models in the MONAI Bundle format. All source code of models (bundles) are tracked in models/, and for each distinct version of a bundle, it will be archived as a .zip file (named in the form of bundle_name_version.zip) and stored in Releases.
